feedback.goal: Repair the transport-test process mock so asynchronous worker IPC remains functional without changing production behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Preserve Node scheduling and IPC APIs while observing selected credential reads.
Pass focused fork-pool tests and the complete local gate.

outcome.summary: All five environment-only process stubs were replaced with a delegating test helper. Scheduling regression and full local checks pass; production behavior is unchanged.

what_worked: CI logs identified a missing Node process API rather than a provider or production failure.
The regression preserves nextTick and IPC while credential assertions remain active.
what_failed: The prior environment-only mock removed process.nextTick and caused asynchronous worker IPC exceptions in CI despite successful individual assertions.

calls.name: vitest-fork-pool
calls.purpose: Run the repaired transport tests with fork workers.

evidence.summary: 250 transport tests passed using the fork pool with two workers, including nextTick/setImmediate scheduling and process.send preservation under credential observation.

778 tests passed with seven opt-in skips. Typecheck/build, all capsules, policy and both offline scorecards passed. No production code, schema, paid ledger or trial evidence changed; no provider calls were made.

notes: Test-only correction for the reported PR CI failure. Cleanup, rebaseline and merge remain paused.
